meta.title: Novel Fish
meta.description: Read local novels by actively expanding selected real reasoning steps.

chat.noBook: Select a book under Settings → General → Novel Fish first.
chat.switchHint: Collapse and actively expand this step to read from the current progress.
chat.readError: The passage could not be loaded; progress did not change.
chat.retry: Collapse and actively expand this step to retry.

settings.title: Novel Fish
settings.description: Import and select a book, then choose reading locations from the dropdown. Text loads only on active expansion and is never sent to the model.
settings.chooseTarget: Select a real reasoning step to add…
settings.targetHint: Add multiple locations here without closing settings. Selecting a location does not consume text.
settings.noAvailableTargets: No loaded reasoning steps. Expand the native process/completed group in chat, then return and refresh this list.
settings.emptyLibrary: Import an EPUB, TXT, or MD file to begin.
settings.presetHint: Choose presets without typing; an input appears only when Custom is selected.
settings.removeConfirm: Delete {title} and its local reading progress?
